lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is tighter in the anterior section near the shoulder and becomes wider and more regular across the ribcage and flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the seventh vertical line (counting from anterior to posterior), where the line splits into two branches near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-torso. The fifth line is a faint, discontinuous segment. Several posterior lines show minor breaks as they approach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated primarily in the lower-central region of the haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the mid-haunch align along a horizontal axis, while the remaining spots form a loose, non-linear triangular cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the eyes, white spotting on the muzzle and lower cheek, and distinct white markings on the lower limbs appearing as high-contrast socks above the hooves.
